points.why: Describes the trust-scrutiny-fewer-catches reinforcing loop and notes the 'almost never found a problem' stat is partly a product of light checking.
Tabulates boundary and kind for CI and human review, says unit tests are the same kind, and recommends canary/staged rollout with auto-rollback or environment validation.
Proposes risk-based scrutiny independent of track record, fixed-share sampling, and an explicit-confirmation gate for checkout config.
Recommends tracking review time and comments per agent PR, and explicitly avoids blaming the reviewer or calling the agent unreliable.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly says the postmortem should not blame the reviewer.
Calls unit tests a minor item at most and makes other checks the main fixes.
